Approach International Student Center · TED Talks: Ideas Worth Sharing
The course
In 11 weeks, you will plan, rehearse and deliver your own TED-style talk.
Guided by Chris Anderson's book, TED Talks: The Official TED Guide to Public Speaking, and real TED Talks.
B2 · a 4–5 minute talk
B2+ · a 6–7 minute talk
Approach International Student Center · TED Talks: Ideas Worth Sharing
How it works
Every week has the same rhythm
Read
A short excerpt from Anderson's book
Watch
One model TED Talk to analyze
Learn
The English you need for this stage of your talk
Practice
Speak, get feedback and try again
Build
A milestone that becomes part of your final talk
Approach International Student Center · TED Talks: Ideas Worth Sharing
Course materials
What you need
The book
Chris Anderson, TED Talks: The Official TED Guide to Public Speaking (2016). One short excerpt each week.
Worksheets and slides
Provided by the school every week.
TED.com or the TED app
Free. Use it to watch the weekly model talk.
A phone or device
To record your practice talks.
Approach International Student Center · TED Talks: Ideas Worth Sharing
Learning outcomes
By the end of the course, you will be able to…
1
Identify a talk's core idea, throughline and structure
2
Read an excerpt from Anderson's book and explain its advice
3
Build a talk around one idea, with a throughline of 15 words or fewer
4
Use talk tools: story, explanation, persuasion and visuals
5
Use signposting, narrative tenses, analogies, hedging and data language
6
Deliver a rehearsed talk with clear stress, pausing, eye contact, and a strong opening and close
7
Give and respond to constructive peer feedback

Course policies
Good to know
Deadlines
Milestones are due at the start of the next session.
Late work
Loses 10% per day, for up to three days.
Missing Week 6 or 11
You may present at the next session only with prior notice and documentation.
Your recordings
For feedback only. Never shared outside class without your permission.

Code of Conduct
How we work together in the classroom
To attend in-person classes, you must:
Classroom rules
1
Arrive on time and stay in the class for the whole lesson.
2
Speak only English in the classroom.
3
Respect your teachers and classmates.
4
Put your cell phone away and focus on the lesson.
5
Come prepared: bring completed homework and materials, and actively participate in class activities.
Approach International Student Center · 2026 In-Person Code of Conduct
To provide a safe and focused learning environment for everyone, children and babies are not permitted in class.
